fact_text: A shooting star candle forming at a resistance level, at the top of a channel, or below a moving average during an uptrend is a bearish reversal signal, whatever its colour.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Shooting Star Candlestick Pattern | Technical Analysis for Beginners | PSX Chart Guide' (YouTube, 2025-07-26)

fact_text: On the KSE-100 chart, a shooting star at a major resistance and later one at a broken channel top were each followed by a sharp fall, which the analyst used to show the pattern's reversal effect.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Shooting Star Candlestick Pattern | Technical Analysis for Beginners | PSX Chart Guide' (YouTube, 2025-07-26)
